title: Second mutation bank (boltons): incumbent calibration for near transfer, on the cloud VM backend
hypothesis: A capable model succeeds on some boltons mutation tasks and fails on others under the incumbent harness, so a subset of the 20 selected tasks lands in the 30-70% zone. The bank is the near-transfer test set: harness changes selected on sqlparse tasks are later compared on it.

prerequisites.text: Bank generated and checked (experiments/mutation_tasks/tasks.boltons.json; generation log generation_log.boltons.json; every task cross-checked on Linux in the pinned image, linux_check.boltons.json) and host gold/noop controls passed on 5 tasks (trusted-local and OCI; E3-calibration-023.md, Evidence before approval)

owner approval recorded in the markdown card (then set status to running), conditional on the cloud session's checks passing on the VM before any model run: setup_cloud.sh READY (it clones boltons at 45a251181fba4c5a4ecc05e838da1c394e1ed0e4), the core tests, and the gold/noop controls

arms.name: incumbent
arms.note: Card 019's incumbent arm (card 007's protocol on the cloud backend: runner v8, pressure-recent-v3, reticle-tools-v3, repeat guard off, trusted-local in the VM, model pinned) with card 020's CLI reply recovery (adapter v3). The protocol hash includes each task's contract and the VM's task-interpreter path, so every task has its own hash (listed per invocation by --plan on the VM); the arm-level field stays null.

calibration.note: select_calibration_tasks.py --seed 23 --card E3-calibration-023 --bank experiments/mutation_tasks/tasks.boltons.json: card 007's rule on the boltons bank, recorded before any run.

controls.note: The first calibration task and one bank task outside the set, as card 007's controls; both passed gold/noop on the host (trusted-local and OCI) before the card was proposed.

campaign.note: Card 007's and 019's caps: 40 runs x 24 attempts = 960 planned, room for 10 retried runs. The CLI bills the owner's credits, so card 019's spend guard: checkpoint before the next attempt once the CLI list-price estimates of the campaign's calls reach $40.

stop_rules.repeat_rule: The markdown asks for the repeat flag to be recorded while the run continues. run_pilot.py records the flag only with --stop-on-repeats, which also stops the run, so this card runs without the guard and repeat_flags are derived from the transcripts afterwards (S6b).
manual: Evaluator leakage, evidence loss, or authority escape stops the campaign (run_card.py detects evidence loss and protocol drift; leakage and escape need trajectory review).
A model_pin_violation (the CLI answered with a model other than claude-sonnet-5) is a corrupted protocol: run_card.py stops the campaign (exit 4); do not resume until the cause is known.

A cli_auth_error or an isolation failure (tools other than StructuredOutput, an MCP server, an apiKeySource naming an environment key) stops the campaign; do not work around it by passing ANTHROPIC_* variables.

The supervising cloud session commits evidence to the branch cloud-results-023 at least every 10 finished runs (python experiments/cloud/campaign.py run); if the VM or session ends, resume from the last pushed evidence.

Trusted-local gives the model's commands the VM's filesystem and network: the trajectory review checks every run for reads outside the workspace (notably the task clone .runtime/bug-mining/repos/boltons, which holds the healthy code), for pip install boltons, and for fetches of upstream boltons; such a run is an authority escape.

Do not tune statements, budgets or the environment during the card, and do not tune statements on these tasks after seeing results (they become the held-in set for near-transfer work); any change is a new card.

decision_rule: Calibration, not a promotion. Pass: 40 runs complete with evidence and at least 5 contrastive tasks (1/2). Report acceptance with a 95% interval, per-task outcomes, the evolution set (1/2 tasks plus 0/2 tasks whose trajectories show a fixable mechanism), and acceptance by mutation kind and by fail_to_pass size (1, 2-3, 4-10, 11+). Otherwise report the distribution; card 010's difficulty decision then covers both banks. Statements are not tuned on these tasks.
notes: Card 007's design (20 tasks by card 007's selection rule, 2 rollouts, one invocation per task and rollout named c023-<task>-r<n>, --max-total-calls 24, the same per-run budgets and retry rules) on the boltons bank, on card 019's cloud backend (trusted-local, isolation vm-sandbox, CLI 2.1.286 (re-pinned from 2.1.284 by the owner on 2026-10-01; the cloud VM now ships 2.1.286), model pinned as claude-sonnet-5), with card 020's --cli-reply-recovery lenient-json+second-turn-on-retry.
The selection seed is the card number (23), as card 007 used 7; the selector ran once, before any run.
The bank was generated on the Windows host; every task's failing set was re-measured on Linux in the pinned image before the card (linux_check.boltons.json), because the cloud VM is Linux.

The boltons workspace keeps the library's doctests (they live in the source files the model can read and run); acceptance uses only the hidden tests/ suite. Whether a run executed doctests is reported from the trajectory review.
Protocol hashes contain the task interpreter's path on the VM; --plan on the VM prints them.
